title: NYC open data explorer
summary: An explorer of New York City's open data catalogue built from the city's public datasets: search, filter and profile what is published.

made.request: Grab all the open data we can find about Manhattan and New York City. A lot is public: street trees, parking, 311 complaints and much more. Check what can actually be fetched, then build a dashboard I can navigate, with details about each dataset. If something needs data you cannot reach, tell me.
